input.quote: 28.1 This Agreement is governed exclusively by Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction.
input.rationale: Section 28.1 selects Singapore law with exclusive Singapore courts — a jurisdiction outside the accepted list (New York, Delaware, California, England and Wales) and, as an exclusive foreign forum, walk-away territory. It also conflicts directly with Section 28.2, which gives exclusive jurisdiction to the state and federal courts in New York County. The minimal fix aligns 28.1 with the preferred position and with 28.2 by substituting New York law and the New York County courts, leaving 28.2's venue submission and 28.3's escalation process intact.

proposal.summary: Change governing law and forum in 28.1 from Singapore to New York law and New York County courts, consistent with 28.2.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have replaced Singapore law and exclusive Singapore courts with New York law and the New York County courts, which is our standard position and removes the conflict with Section 28.2's exclusive New York venue. If New York is not workable, we can accept Delaware, California, or England and Wales (London courts).

ops.oldText: Singapore law, and the courts of Singapore have exclusive jurisdiction
ops.newText: the law of the State of New York, and the state and federal courts located in New York County, New York have exclusive jurisdiction
